roadmap.pageDescription: Epics over time, from the dates of their items. Select a bar to open the epic.
roadmap.emptyBody: An epic is a large piece of work that groups related stories across sprints. Create a work item of type Epic and add stories to it: it then appears here with its dates and progress.
roadmap.chooseProject: Choose a project to see its sprints above the timeline.
roadmap.loadError: Could not load the sprint report

workloadPage.capacityError: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
workloadPage.title: Workload
workloadPage.description: Story points and items per person against their capacity. Select a person to see their tasks.
workloadPage.rangeInvalid: The start date must be on or before the end date.
workloadPage.noSprintBody: Plan a sprint in a project and assign its tasks. Or switch to a date range to see work by due date.
workloadPage.invalidRangeBody: Pick a start date that is on or before the end date.
workloadPage.noWorkSprint: This sprint has no tasks yet. Add tasks to it from the project page, then assign them to see who carries what.
workloadPage.noWorkRange: No tasks fall between these dates. Widen the range or pick another project.
workloadPage.summary: {{items}} · {{points}} pts. A task with several assignees counts for each person.

reportPage.title: {{name}} report
reportPage.nothingToBurn: No tasks were in this sprint, so there is nothing to burn down.
reportPage.burndownLater: The burndown appears once the sprint has started and has tasks.
reportPage.emptyCompleted: Nothing was completed in this sprint yet.
reportPage.emptyNotCompleted: Everything in this sprint is done.
reportPage.emptyAdded: No work was added after the sprint started.
reportPage.emptyRemoved: No work was removed from the sprint.
reportPage.completedNote: Open work that was moved out when the sprint was completed is found from recorded moves; items created directly inside the sprint may be missing from Not completed.
reportPage.loadFailed: We could not load this report
reportPage.loadNext: Check your connection and try again. If the sprint was deleted, pick another one from the project.
reportPage.notFoundBody: The sprint may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
